task: How fast do refunds have to go out?
answer:
Sinew has no document about the required timeline for issuing refunds.

* The "Refund policy" document outlines approval limits for care agents, leads, and the head of operations.
* It does not specify a required timeframe for processing refunds.

data.title: Refund policy
data.heading: Who can approve a refund
data.text: Care agents may refund up to $80. The care lead approves up to $400; above that, the head of operations.
